response.overview: A high school group project quickly turns from a fun cabin trip into to the worst night of their lives. Nine teenagers get together to film the wildlife of northern Waupanee, hoping to make an impactful senior project and some good memories. However, things aren't as they seem in the woods. As events spiral out of control, the students can no longer trust themselves to make the right decisions, and make sacrifices no one expected them to.
response.title: Look At Me
